statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 13 (low) with NQ about +0.2% and drifting to the top of a roughly 73-point band since the 22:00Z Globex reopen, on a small and orderly overnight move.
recommendation: Tail at 13 maps to EA_ON under the fixed repository mapping. Ninety minutes into the Globex reopen NQ has extended the top of its band to about 30,852 and trades near 30,847, roughly +0.2%, on two independent delayed feeds. That is a mild upward drift in thin pre-Asia liquidity rather than the persistent one-way structure that defines path risk, and the published score reflects the observed path rather than the size of Monday's record-setting advance. On present evidence the mapped state is projected to stay at EA_ON overnight and to reach WATCH only between 13:00Z and 17:00Z on Tuesday, around the cash open, the opening of the UN General Assembly general debate and the Richmond Fed, Williams and Jefferson cluster. Tail remains below the blocking threshold across the entire published 24-hour path.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures drift to the top of a narrow overnight band after Monday's record AI-led advance
body: Monday's US cash session ended with the Nasdaq-100 at 30,482.35, up 2.83% and 75 points under its 30,557.33 session high, while the Nasdaq Composite set a record close at 27,122.09 (+2.26%), the S&P 500 closed at 7,764.70 (+1.49%) and the Dow at 52,048.83 (+0.71%). The catalyst was the early traction of Meta's Muse agentic-AI assistant: Meta rose 11.34%, Arm about 17%, Intel about 12%, Qualcomm 9.3% and AMD 9.95% to $615.52 as it passed a $1 trillion market value, with all eight tracked megacaps and all seven tracked semiconductors higher on the session. The decisive current evidence, however, is the Globex tape. Since the 22:00Z reopen NQ has traded between about 30,778.50 and 30,851.75 and now sits near 30,847, about +0.2%, with a second independent delayed feed showing 30,838 against a 30,784.75 previous close. Price is close to the upper edge of that band, but the band is only about 73 points wide on a 30,800 index and the drift has developed over ninety minutes of thin pre-Asia liquidity, so it is recorded as a mild directional lean rather than the persistent, retracement-free structure that defines path risk. Cross-assets remain supportive rather than confirming stress: VIX settled at 14.87 against a 2.8% index day, the 10-year yield eased 3.5 basis points to about 4.963% and WTI fell 4.51% to about $95.61 with Brent near $100.19, a fourth consecutive decline as Strait of Hormuz shipments recovered and traders positioned for possible US-Iran contact at the UN General Assembly. That diplomatic channel is two-sided: the general debate opens Tuesday morning with President Trump scheduled to speak early and Iran's President Pezeshkian on Wednesday, and reporting describes the underlying efforts as stalled, so both a de-escalation headline and an escalation headline are live possibilities during Tuesday's US session. Stress is scored at 35 to carry that headline exposure together with the size of Monday's repricing, and Confidence at 86 reflects live futures quotes from two feeds, confirmed cash closes, current volatility, yield and crude levels and a verified calendar. The shared Finviz context file was 130 minutes old and marked partial at assessment time, so it was not relied on for current structure; its latest-session breadth figures are consistent with the independently verified megacap and semiconductor moves. The published path holds Tail in the low band overnight, lifts it into the watch band for the Tuesday US session with a peak of 23 in the 14:00Z window, and never reaches the blocking threshold on present evidence.

lookbackSummary: Over the preceding 24 hours Tail traced a full arc from 5 in the quiet Asian hours to a peak of 33 during the US afternoon, as a broad agentic-AI advance held the index near session extremes with aligned megacap and semiconductor participation. The published series ran green through 10:00Z, yellow from 11:00Z, orange from 14:00Z to 19:00Z, then stepped back to yellow at 23 once the 20:00Z cash settle removed the opening-auction and closing-imbalance mechanisms, and to green at 14 and then 12 through the maintenance halt and the Globex reopen. Stress followed the same path from 34 to a 57 peak before easing to 35, and Confidence improved from 75 to 90 as live evidence accumulated, then eased to 85-86 when the futures tape went dark and restarted.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds Tail in the low band across the entire overnight cycle, troughing at 11 through the Asian session, then lifting into the watch band for the Tuesday US session with a peak of 23 in the 14:00Z window that covers the cash-open aftermath and the Richmond Fed, Williams and Jefferson cluster. A second, smaller plateau at 20 spans the 17:00Z coincidence of the US 2-year auction and Fed Barkin remarks, which is the credible delayed-second-leg mechanism for the late session. Mapped policy state is projected to stay at EA_ON overnight and to reach WATCH only between 13:00Z and 17:00Z, never touching the blocking threshold on current evidence. The narrow danger window spans 13:00Z to 16:00Z on 22 September, covering the opening of the UN General Assembly general debate and the 13:30Z cash open. The invalidations that would lift Tail beyond this path are an opening-auction continuation with shallow or failed retracements, the index holding near fresh extremes, an unresolved delayed second leg after front-end repricing, or a geopolitical discontinuity out of the UNGA sessions transmitted through crude.
